title: k-Nearest Neighbours with scikit-learn
learning_objectives: Fit KNeighborsClassifier inside a scaling pipeline
Compare test accuracy across values of k
Explain how k trades variance for bias
hints: Inside the loop build a new pipeline for each k, fit it and call `accuracy_score(y_test, pipe.predict(X_test))`.
`best_k = min(ks, key=lambda k: (-accuracy[k], k))` picks the highest accuracy, then the smallest k.

failure_feedback.advice: Scale inside the pipeline: make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), KNeighborsClassifier(k)).
On equal accuracy choose the smallest k.
Reject an empty list and any k outside 1..len(X_train).
